_doc: THE PROSE BYTE BASELINE — the composed-prose corpus's own size ratchet (ARCH-COMPOSED-PROSE §10, §12 row 2; lane MEASURE car 2). It freezes the RAW and GZIP bytes of every SOURCE leaf the dossier's state and causal prose is projected into, and it bounds their growth at the model's declared CEILING. It is a SOURCE read, so it is lawful in the plain pre-build `npm run test` phase: unlike the dist-reading contracts in tests/build/, nothing here can measure a stale artefact, because the artefact is the committed file. Consumed by tests/lint/proseCorpusBytes.test.js and by NOTHING else. ⛔ THIS IS NOT scripts/.size-baseline.json AND MUST NEVER BECOME A ROW IN IT: that file is a max-LINES instrument whose ceilingFor() returns null for src/data/**, so a byte row planted there would be read by eslint.config.js as a max-lines ceiling of 641410 and would red both of its consumers. Two instruments, two rulers, no overlap. ARCH §11 states the refusal in its own words: 'no .size-baseline.json byte row; no second first-paint ruler.'
_instrument: RAW is the exact instrument: a leaf's `raw` must EQUAL the bytes on disk. Above fails, below fails (lower the row and bank the shrink) — the sizeBaseline honesty idiom, applied to bytes instead of effective lines. GZIP is level 9 over the same bytes and is asserted as a BAND (±1 %) rather than an equality, and that is deliberate: gzip output is a function of the zlib build as well as the payload, and this estate has already ruled once that a ratchet which reds on a toolchain upgrade has stopped measuring the payload (tests/build/vendorPdfLazy.test.js, the compressed-ceilings block). The ±1 % band is TIGHTER than the ~5 % platform margin that file's own transfer budgets carry for the same hazard, and it costs nothing in coverage because the RAW arm above it is exact: no byte can move through this file unseen.
_ceilingArithmetic: The CEILING is ARCH §10's, not this file's invention. §10 sizes the corpus on measured unit costs: today's six state leaves faced and render-meta'd ≈ 1.78 MB; the modifier pools' render fields ≈ 30 KB; new pieces at the CEILING (≈ 1200 semantic pieces ≈ 960 KB) ⇒ ≈ 2.8 MB raw for the SIX STATE LEAVES TOGETHER. `ceilingTotalRawStateLeaves` is that 2,800,000, and each state leaf's `ceilingRaw` is that total APPORTIONED BY ITS SHARE OF TODAY'S CORPUS: round(2800000 × genesis.raw ÷ 641410). The six rounded shares sum to exactly 2,800,000 with no remainder to allocate (asserted). Every leaf therefore carries the same 4.3654× headroom, which is the point: the ratchet is set from the CEILING so car 8's rewrite-and-faces wave cannot breach it, and a leaf that grows out of proportion to the rest still reds. `ceilingGzip` is round(ceilingRaw ÷ 4.5), §10's over-the-wire ratio at the ceiling (distinct faces raise entropy below today's measured 5.27 : 1); the six sum to 622,222, inside §10's stated 0.5–0.65 MB band (asserted).
_causalLeafGround: THE CAUSAL LEAF TAKES NO HEADROOM, AND THAT IS A RULING, NOT AN OVERSIGHT. Its ceilingRaw and ceilingGzip equal its genesis bytes. Three grounds: ARCH §11 refuses 'no wording sets on the causal register in wave one'; §12 car 13 (the causal register R2) is OWNER-GATED, 'wire or retire'; and the leaf reaches NO EMITTED CHUNK at all at this tip (measured by lane MEASURE car 2 at a fresh build: src/domain/display/stateProse/causalDossierProse.js has no product importer, only tests and doc references, so DOSSIER_CAUSAL_PROSE ships zero bytes to any reader today — a measured correction to §10, which states the causal leaf 'rides the data-lazy-* chunk'). A car that wires it is the owner's, and it must move this row through a declared row like any other growth.
_declaredRowIdiom: MONOTONE, SHRINK-ONLY, EXCEPT THROUGH A DECLARED ROW THAT NAMES THE CAR AND THE DELTA — and the idiom is MACHINE-CHECKED, not a promise in prose. A shrink needs no declaration: lower the leaf's `raw`/`gzip` and the win is banked. A GROWTH needs an entry appended to `declared`: { car, leaf, fromRaw, toRaw, gzipAfter, reason }. The test then reconstructs each leaf's whole history: the declared rows for a leaf, in file order, must CHAIN — the first row's fromRaw equals that leaf's `genesis.raw`, each later row's fromRaw equals the previous row's toRaw, and the LAST row's toRaw equals the leaf's CURRENT `raw` and its gzipAfter equals the leaf's current `gzip`. A leaf with no declared row must sit EXACTLY at its genesis value. So a number cannot be raised without a declared row landing on it: raise the row alone and the chain no longer reaches today's bytes, and the suite reds naming the leaf. Every declared toRaw must also stay at or under the leaf's `ceilingRaw`; a car that needs more than the ceiling is asking to amend ARCH §10 and §13 row 17, which is the owner's row, not a lane's. `reason` is prose for a reader; the machine does not read it, and a car that leaves it empty has declared nothing.
_newLeafCeilingArithmetic: THE THREE LEAVES SEAM CAR 4 ADDS (src/data/dossierConnectives.generated.js, proseNorms.generated.js, dossierRelations.generated.js) are NOT state desk leaves and take their own total: ARCH §10 prices them at 'the three leaves ≈ 77 KB either way', so `ceilingTotalRawNewLeaves` is 77,000 and each leaf's ceilingRaw is that total APPORTIONED BY ITS SHARE OF THEIR GENESIS BYTES: round(77000 × genesis.raw ÷ 49539). The three rounded shares sum to exactly 77,000 with no remainder (asserted), and ceilingGzip is round(ceilingRaw ÷ 4.5) at the same over-the-wire ratio the state leaves use. ⚠ A MEASURED FINDING FOR THE SITTING, RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN SOLVED BY A LARGER NUMBER: the NORM leaf's growth law is ONE ROW PER FIRING POOL at about 73.6 B per row, so its 30,990 B ceiling is reached at about 421 rows. It holds 271 today, and ARCH §6.6 sizes up to 174 new modifier pools before the corpus ceiling, which lands near 445. §10's three-leaf estimate is therefore likely to need re-pricing during car 9, and that is an ARCH §10 amendment and an owner row (§13 row 17), not a lane's edit. SEAM car 4 sets the ceiling AT §10's own number rather than above it, on purpose: a lane that quietly gave itself headroom would have amended the architecture by arithmetic. ⚠ AND THE GZIP CEILING TAKES THE LARGER OF TWO RATIOS, WHICH THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF FORCED. §10's 4.5 : 1 is a CORPUS ratio and it does not hold on a small payload: gzip's fixed header and Huffman tables cost the same on 1,365 bytes as on 250,000, so the connectives leaf compresses at 1.72 : 1 and round(2122 ÷ 4.5) = 472 would have been a ceiling ALREADY BREACHED at the leaf's birth (measured 795 B). The first run of this ratchet said so by name, which is what a ratchet is for. So ceilingGzip is max(round(ceilingRaw × 10 ÷ ceilingGzipRatioTenths), round(genesis.gzip × ceilingRaw ÷ genesis.raw)): §10's ratio where the payload is large enough for it to hold, and the leaf's OWN measured ratio where it is not. The six state leaves are unaffected — every one of them is large and §10's ratio is the larger term there.

declared.car: REWRITE car 8a-9 (the brief's item 9; S12, SITTING §T.2) — the four connective lists to their floors as PUBLIC-COPY DRAFTS
declared.reason: EIGHT NEW JOINTS AND A RE-WRITTEN HEADER, and not one rendered byte with them. `consequence.clause` and `tension.sentence` went 0 -> 3 and `contrast.sentence` and `addition.sentence` 1 -> 3, the EMPTY OPENER keeping its place at the head of the two lists that assert adjacency itself. A list length is the modulus of the joint draw, so this growth is ALSO a declared row on the SHIFT REGISTER's `connective-list-length` mechanism -- and it re-rolled NOTHING, measured rather than argued: no shipped pool declares `role: modifier`, so the composer draws no joint on any town, and the classifier printed every one of the 73,284 cells UNCHANGED. The six PROSE leaves are byte-identical; this is the only leaf that moved, it moved by 681 raw bytes, and it sits under its own ceiling of 2,122. The lists are PUBLIC-COPY DRAFTS signed at the walk (S12; SITTING §T.2; §13 row 27).

declared.car: REWRITE car 8b-W (ADDENDUM 4; the SEAM car 3h shape) — the defense desk's wiring car
declared.reason: TWENTY-ONE `readsCount` LINES AND NOTHING ELSE, at 25 bytes each. Five key tables were exposed so the wiring register could recover their predicates on its TABLE rung — DS-DEF-1's readiness bands, DS-DEF-3's two label tables, DS-DEF-4's capture ladder and DS-DEF-6's supply family — which moved twenty-one pools from WIRING-UNRESOLVED to RESOLVED (340 to 361). `poolMeta.readsCount` is projected from the census and is ABSENT where the census reads nothing, so re-taking the census obliges the projector to write one line per newly resolved pool. Classified line by line, every changed line of BOTH regenerated leaves is a `readsCount` line: 21 added here, one CHANGED in general.generated.js (DS-GEN-6 :: isolated, 3 to 1, no length change and so no row of its own) and not one `text`, `vid`, `angle`, `marks` or `slots` byte anywhere. The classifier reads UNCHANGED on all 73,284 cells against f73bdbf16, and gzip does not move at all (23,039 before and after), which is what one metadata line repeated twenty-one times compresses to. The leaf sits at 155,118 of its 488,168 ceiling.

declared.car: REWRITE cars 8b-W-18c … 8b-W-18m (the FACES landing on the first v3 pool), DECLARED RETROSPECTIVELY at car 8b-W-18o-r
declared.reason: ⛔ THIS ROW IS LATE AND THE LATENESS IS THE FINDING. The bytes moved when the first v3 pool took its faces — `DS-DEF-2 :: Invasion & War: walls with NO force` grew from one face per variant to four, and each face carries a `sources` entry, a `pairs` entry and (on two variants) role and verb slots. The +2,007 B is that pool and nothing else: the projector's `--check` is green, the census verifies 708 pools / 2,266 variants, and no other leaf moved a byte. What did NOT happen is the declared row: cars 18c, 18i, 18k, 18l and 18m each landed green on their own gates and none of them ran this ratchet, so the growth sat undeclared until car 8b-W-18o-r ran the full byte measurement the brief asked for (reconciliation item 9) and the ratchet named the leaf and the delta — which is exactly what it is for. The row is appended here rather than in a car of its own because the chain must reach today's bytes for the instrument to work at all, and a red ratchet helps nobody. ⭐ NO CEILING IS TOUCHED AND NONE IS NEAR: the leaf sits at 157,125 of an owner-signed 488,168 (32.2 per cent), and the six state leaves together at 887,260 of 2,800,000 (31.7 per cent). The ceilings are ARCH §10's and the owner's; this row moves only the MEASUREMENT. ⚠ THE HAZARD, NAMED SO THE NEXT LANE DOES NOT REPEAT IT: this ratchet is not in the per-commit gate list any 8b car has been running (`git show 95760e212` names the suites and this is not among them). Every v3 pool from here grows its leaf, so every cure commit owes a declared row — add `npx vitest run tests/lint/proseCorpusBytes.test.js` to the lane's gate.

declared.car: REWRITE car 8b-W-18n/18o (C) — THE FIRST POOL RE-CUT under rulings 27, 28, 30, 37 and 40
declared.reason: The first v3 pool takes the two forms ADDENDUM 18 created and loses the frames ruling 40 struck. TWO FACES ADDED: an `[archiver · observed]` face on variant 2 and a `[public]` face on variant 3 (faceCounts 4,4,4 → 4,5,5; the shift register's `face-count-per-variant` row carries the re-roll). Against that, THREE SPINES AND THE HALL'S PAIR HALF WERE SHORTENED: ruling 40 struck 'The survey finds …' and 'Entered here as kept.' from spine 1 and 'The survey finds the watch on the walls …' from the watch's face, and ruling 30 cut the hall's half from two sentences to one so the pair is compoundable. The net is small because the re-cut gives back nearly what the new faces cost, which is the cap doing its work. ⭐ NO CEILING IS NEAR: the leaf sits far under the owner-signed 488,168. ⚠ AND THIS COMMIT IS THE FIRST 8b CURE TO RUN THIS RATCHET AT ALL — the row before it banks the growth five earlier cars left undeclared.

declared.car: REWRITE 8b DS-DEF-2 draft (v3) — THREE POOLS APPLIED VERBATIM AT THE DRAFT GATE
declared.reason: The 8b DS-DEF-2 DRAFT gate lands THREE MORE POOLS of the block under the v3 workflow, each replacing three bare spine rows with a spine plus its wording faces, applied VERBATIM from the selectors' packets. `Invasion & War: force with NO walls` 1,1,1 → 6,6,6 (five faces a variant); `Internal Security: no legal infrastructure` 1,1,1 → 11,8,8 (the block's widest seated roster, ten faces behind variant 1's spine); `Disasters & Famine: NO reserves, NO medical provision` 1,1,1 → 6,6,6. Forty-five new wording rows and seven marked pairs in all, against nine spine rows re-cut and no row removed. ⭐ THE GROWTH IS THE FACES THEMSELVES and nothing else: no slot, no mark and no leaf key was added, and the shift register's `face-count-per-variant` row carries the corpus sum 2277 → 2331, the largest entry 5 → 11 and the per-pool digest. ⭐ NO CEILING IS NEAR — 167,290 raw against the owner-signed 488,168, and 26,151 gzip against 108,482. ⛔ TERMINUS RE-POINTED BY A SHRINK, NOT BY A NEW GROW: the 8b DS-DEF-2 CURE gate (v3) applied eleven cured faces across the same three pools and the leaf FELL 167,290 → 167,288 raw and 26,151 → 26,147 gzip. A shrink owes no declared row (this instrument's own TO-COMPLY idiom), so no row was appended; but the chain must land EXACTLY on the committed bytes, so THIS row's `toRaw` and `gzipAfter` were lowered onto them and the win is banked. The DRAFT car's landing is unchanged in every other respect and is stated above; only the terminus moved, and it moved DOWN.

declared.car: REWRITE 8b DS-DEF-2 draft (v3), SECOND SITTING — FIVE POOLS APPLIED VERBATIM AT THE DRAFT GATE
declared.reason: The 8b DS-DEF-2 DRAFT gate lands FIVE MORE POOLS of the block under the v3 workflow, each replacing three bare spine rows with a spine plus its wording faces, applied VERBATIM from the selectors' packets. `Beasts & Monsters: frontier, credible deterrence` 1,1,1 → 12,12,11 (eleven, eleven and ten faces behind the spines); `Invasion & War: walls AND professional garrison` 1,1,1 → 6,6,6; `Internal Security: full legal chain (court AND prison)` 1,1,1 → 10,11,10; `Economic Survival: STRONG` 1,1,1 → 12,11,9; `Disasters & Famine: granary AND hospital` 1,1,1 → 10,10,10. ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-ONE new wording rows and twenty-three marked pairs plus TWO ARCHIVER WEIGH ROWS in all, against fifteen spine rows re-cut and no row removed. ⭐ THE GROWTH IS THE FACES THEMSELVES and two marks taking their first corpus seats: `Economic Survival: STRONG` is the first pool anywhere to carry the archiver's `weigh` (ruling 22) and the `compromised` flag (ruling 26), and it takes a second seat for the archiver's `observed` (ruling 27). The shift register's `face-count-per-variant` row carries the corpus sum 2331 → 2462, the largest entry 11 → 12 and the per-pool digest. ⭐ NO CEILING IS NEAR — 192,616 raw against the owner-signed 488,168, and 30,821 gzip against 108,482.

declared.car: REWRITE 8b DS-DEF-2 draft (v3), THIRD SITTING — FIVE OF SIX PACKETS APPLIED VERBATIM AT THE DRAFT GATE, THE SIXTH REFUSED
declared.reason: The 8b DS-DEF-2 DRAFT gate lands FIVE MORE POOLS of the block under the v3 workflow, each replacing three bare spine rows with a spine plus its wording faces, applied VERBATIM from the selectors' packets. `Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter but NO force to hold it` 1,1,1 → 11,10,10; `Beasts & Monsters: frontier, force without a perimeter` 1,1,1 → 12,12,12 (eleven faces behind every one of its three spines); `Invasion & War: walls with citizen militia` 1,1,1 → 7,8,8; `Internal Security: court without detention` 1,1,1 → 11,8,9; `Economic Survival: WEAK` 1,1,1 → 11,10,9. That pool is the chair's to cut and re-gate. ⭐ THE GROWTH IS THE FACES THEMSELVES and nothing else: no slot, no mark and no leaf key was added, no `archiver`, `public`, `observed` or `weigh` is seated by any of the five, and the shift register's `face-count-per-variant` row carries the corpus sum 2462 → 2595, the largest entry UNCHANGED at 12 and the per-pool digest. ⭐ NO CEILING IS NEAR — 217,867 raw against the owner-signed 488,168 (44.6 per cent), and 35,505 gzip against 108,482.

declared.car: REWRITE 8b DS-DEF-2 cure (v3) — SIX OF SIX PACKETS APPLIED VERBATIM AT THE CURE GATE
declared.reason: The 8b DS-DEF-2 CURE gate applies all SIX curers' packets verbatim. FIVE of them were already seated at the draft gate and re-cut wordings INSIDE the face counts they already had — those five move the payload by re-wording alone, not by adding rows. The SIXTH is the pool the DRAFT GATE REFUSED: `Disasters & Famine: granary AND parish care only` kept its three shipped spine rows there because its spine 3 carried `from the road`, a PROVENANCE move of `moveGrammar.js:225` that would have taken the shrink-only citation ratchet in `tests/lint/proseComposed.walker.test.js` from 7 to 8. THE CURE PACKET'S OWN TARGET v3/0 REMOVES THAT CLAUSE (`from the road` → `from outside`, which no detector in CLAUSE_DETECTORS reads), so the ground for the refusal is gone and the pool lands whole: faceCounts 1,1,1 → 9,9,7, twenty-two new wording rows and two marked pairs against three spine rows re-cut and no row removed. MEASURED, not asserted: the walker reads 84 passed (84) with this pool landed, so the citing-variant count is still the 7 it pins. The raw leaf grows 217,867 → 223,024 (+5,157) and gzip 35,505 → 36,728 (+1,223) against an owner-signed raw ceiling of 488,168 — 45.7 per cent of it. BOTH ARMS MOVED FOR THE SAME REASON and the gzip move is the payload's, not a zlib build change: the RAW arm reds first and did.
